title: Clone LICHEN-pinned Zephyr v3.7.0 west tree on Attic
description:
The shared Attic west workspace /Volumes/Attic/Developer/zephyr-workspace is upstream Zephyr v4.1.0. LICHEN pins Zephyr v3.7.0 in lichen/west.yml. The in-repo zephyr path is a broken symlink (../zephyr, target missing), so west list from the LICHEN checkout FATALs.

Create a dedicated Attic west tree for the LICHEN pin without mutating the 4.1.0 workspace. Suggested location: /Volumes/Attic/Developer/zephyr-workspace-v3.7.0 (or similar under /Volumes/Attic, never /tmp). Use west init -l against a LICHEN checkout/worktree and west update to clone zephyr at v3.7.0 plus modules. Register ZEPHYR_SDK_INSTALL_DIR=/Volumes/Attic/zephyr-sdk-0.16.8. Do not west init/update /Volumes/Attic/Developer/zephyr-workspace.

After the tree exists, document it in AGENTS.md Local Zephyr/C and update the local-zephyr-workspace memory. Optionally point the repo zephyr symlink at the v3.7.0 clone only if that does not break the 4.1.0 workspace or other agents.
acceptance_criteria: A west workspace on Attic checks out Zephyr v3.7.0 matching lichen/west.yml; west list succeeds from that tree; the 4.1.0 workspace is unchanged; AGENTS.md and bd memory local-zephyr-workspace name the new path; SDK 0.16.8 is used; no writes to /tmp.
